description:
Find music to listen to, explore documented sample connections, or turn your notes and tracklists into a narrated listening pitch. Build ordered queues of songs, videos, SoundCloud recordings, and Internet Archive tracks without commissioning a story. For deeper listening, request a researched music story with sources.

Bring pasted article text, a brief, or exact liner notes to review recording matches and narration before saving a private story on OffStereo. Export a narration passage under 45 seconds as a video saved with source notes; the file contains narration and recording names, not commercial songs or album art.

Useful for music discovery, label and agency pitches, and narrated content drafts. Save selections to OffStereo and eligible songs to connected Apple Music when requested. Playback and previews depend on the source and host. Source citations document connections, not music-rights clearance. Sign in to reopen private stories and downloads.

defaultPrompt: Make a quick playable shortlist of three warm soul songs for a creative pitch. No narrated story or music-service save.
Turn my tracklist and exact notes into a narrated pitch. Show recording matches and narration before saving.
Trace the documented samples in C.R.E.A.M. by Wu-Tang Clan. Cite the evidence and let me hear the source recordings.
